name: GHOST SHIP! Warship Roleplay | WW2 🌊
desc:
Latest Update: New Weather System, Team Selection Menu, Optimisation, & Return to the Alantic!

⚓ WARSHIP ROLEPLAY: WORLD WAR II

Command, fly, and survive in an authentic WW2 naval environment. Positioned aboard an Allied warship in contested waters, your crew must coordinate to maintain operational readiness and defend against hostile threats. Will you command the fleet as Captain, dominate the skies as a Pilot, or save lives as a Navy Doctor?.
